title: Mount Logan Capital Inc. 8-K Filing — Appointment of Chief Operating Officer
summary: Mount Logan Capital Inc. filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026, disclosing the appointment of Jordan Mangum (age 33) as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, effective April 13, 2026. Mangum will continue serving as a Director on the credit team of BC Partners Advisors L.P. while also performing duties for the Company under existing servicing and staffing agreements.
key_points: Jordan Mangum appointed EVP and COO effective April 13, 2026
Mangum currently serves as Director on the credit team of BC Partners Advisors L.P. (BCPA)
Prior experience includes Onex Private Credit (2020-2022) and Bank of America Merrill Lynch Leveraged Finance Group (2015-2020)
Mangum holds dual B.S. degrees in Finance and Accounting from Virginia Tech
Services to be provided under existing Staffing and Resource Agreement (Nov 2025) and Servicing Agreement (March 2023)
Company disclosed potential conflicts of interest related to BCPA's minority equity position and fee-sharing arrangements
